item.title: 0.8.0-beta.3
item.description:
Aki 0.8.0-beta.3

  • A limits ring turns whenever its AI is at work: also while the Claude or Codex app is answering, and during runs with no window of their own.
  • The conversation name of the Claude and Codex apps is asked again while their page isn't showing yet.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.2
item.description:
Aki 0.8.0-beta.2

New

  • Each ring shows, in a small badge, the app its session runs in (Orca, the Codex or Claude app, Terminal…).
  • The Claude and Codex desktop apps' rings show the name of the conversation open in them.

Fixed

  • Sending to the Claude and Codex desktop apps, tested for real: a new conversation, the app minimized, closed or just opened, the focus elsewhere in it, two sends in a row, your own text already in the box.
  • The Codex app no longer adds a ring named "Resources".

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.1
item.description:
Aki 0.8.0-beta.1

New

  • "Wake the agent after" can be set to instant: marks go into the session's tab the moment you send them (Settings).

Changed

  • The line under a limits ring that said "TODAY" is now "PACE": how much you've used against an even week so far. Under 100% is on track.

Aki 0.7.1

Fixed

  • A mark on a localhost page goes to the session serving that page's port, also in a browser window that isn't the one in front (another screen) and right after you were in another session's tab.
  • Send in the History's queue held every mark back with just a beep when one of them was meant for a session that had closed; now the others go, and that one asks where to go.

Changed

  • A Codex ring in a terminal shows the name Codex gave the conversation instead of the folder; an app's ring shows the conversation its window names.

Aki 0.7.0

New

  • Codex's and Claude's desktop apps are destinations too: with one open, it shows as a ring, and its marks are pasted into the conversation open in it, pictures and all, and sent.

Fixed

  • A Codex session working with subagents keeps showing it's working.

Aki 0.6.3

Fixed

  • The first time you marked in Chrome, the Mac asked whether Aki may control it, under the marking overlay: Allow couldn't be clicked and the screen stayed covered. Now marking never brings that question up; the Mac asks once marking is over.
  • Marking a page's own menu (an account dropdown, for example): it closed as you clicked to write the comment; now the screen keeps it, and you can go on marking its items.
  • Marking a page on localhost picks the session serving that port (or named with it, like "3000 …").
  • A long first project name no longer covers the eye that shows or hides the projects.

New

  • A session in Orca shows the name you gave its tab there, not only the title the agent set.
  • You can see when an agent is working: its session's arc turns in its AI's colour (Claude's orange, Codex's green), and the AI's symbol turns on its limits ring. Codex too, the whole time it's thinking.
  • While marking, the chosen session shows the start of what its agent wrote last, so you can tell it's the right one.
  • Right-click a limits ring to choose what it shows (week, today's share or the 5-hour session) and the line under it, or to hide it.

Changed

  • Sessions untouched for more than a day move into the "+N" ring; they come back as soon as they move. The "+N" ring now looks different from a session's ring, and its card lists the sessions you hid apart.
